## Scope and documented goal
Found on PR #122 head cce917969c1ee5c12432668e9d996ff9df14bd83; this concerns the proposed feature, not a claim about a released version.

[ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/cce917969c1ee5c12432668e9d996ff9df14bd83/ARCHITECTURE.md#L681-L695) promises preserved independent edits, retained repeated contenders and explicit resolution. The [canonical feature](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/cce917969c1ee5c12432668e9d996ff9df14bd83/.agents/pm/features/pm-vcs-p7objects.toon) records an ambiguity guard for repeated fields; the equivalent overlapping text case is unguarded.

## Defect
[mergeTrees](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/cce917969c1ee5c12432668e9d996ff9df14bd83/engine/rewrite.ts#L340-L371) retains inherited conflict units alongside newly produced units. Successive unresolved merges over the same original-base text hunk can therefore carry overlapping ranges.

[resolvePayload](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/cce917969c1ee5c12432668e9d996ff9df14bd83/engine/conflicts.ts#L166-L176) sorts units by start, then splices each using its original start/end into the already-mutated line array. Overlapping replacements can overwrite or partially retain a previous choice. All selected units are subsequently removed, without the ambiguity check provided for fields.

## Executed sanitized reproduction
Exact pinned resolvePayload, in-memory typed object store:
- Readable projection: header\nours\nfooter\n
- Two valid text units both cover zero-based range [1,2)
- Their selected alternatives are one\ntwo and three
- Resolve with take=theirs

Actual: header\nthree\ntwo\nfooter\n; no remaining conflict units. Reversing the input unit order produces header\none\ntwo\nfooter\n, again with no conflicts. The first result combines fragments of two alternative choices.

Expected: refuse an ambiguous overlapping selection or require an explicit consolidated choice; do not silently mark all alternatives resolved after sequential stale-coordinate splicing.

Negative control: disjoint ranges [1,2) and [3,4) correctly produce header\none\ntwo\nmiddle\nthree\nfooter\n and clear selected units.

## Producer path and limits
A source-backed producer is three sibling branches editing the same base line, followed by successive record-conflicts merges: inherited unit plus new unit share the projection range. This producer path was inspected, not executed as a full Repository integration test. The resolver was executed unchanged with in-memory storage; this is not an end-to-end CLI reproduction. Canonical hash ordering makes actual ordering deterministic but does not make mixed resolution correct.

## Acceptance/regression criteria
- Full branch/Repository regression with three text contenders, including alternatives of different lengths
- Detect overlapping selected ranges and handle ambiguous alternatives explicitly before publishing
- Apply each explicitly resolved region once with sound coordinates; preserve surrounding independent text
- Retain disjoint-hunk behavior, EOF state, and field ambiguity tests
- Ambiguity refusal leaves HEAD/index/worktree unchanged

All-status issues (122 entries across two REST pages), current PR discussions/reviews and canonical feature were checked. No matching issue was found.

Surrounding/disjoint text, all historical alternatives and EOF choices are checked, as are unchanged HEAD/index/disk/mode/merge-state/operations on refusal. Both full release gates pass 1607/1607 with 100% coverage in every dimension across 66 source files. The issue remains open for review. Additional real-branch regression: node --test --test-name-pattern="^a final zero-width" test/first-class-conflicts.test.ts checks adjacent inherited ranges ending at the same EOF boundary after two recorded merges and an ordinary deletion. Only the rightmost region owns the final newline. All ours/theirs/base choices pass; reverting only that EOF-owner guard fails 0/1 with a missing trailing newline. The full conflict suite is now 44/44.
